Photograph of the white-border [[WHAAAAAAAAAOOOOW! (Revised)]] card published by [[Decipher]]. The Star Wars Collectors Archive credits Duncan Jenkins for the photograph, collection and description.

== Source ==
* Physical white-border face: [https://theswca.com/index.php?action=disp_item&item_id=11074 The Star Wars Collectors Archive], photograph GA08238.JPG by Duncan Jenkins.

== Preparation ==
The 480 × 640-pixel PNG is a crop of the photograph as displayed in the browser's separate image view. Crop rectangle (720, 177, 1200, 817) in the 1920 × 993-pixel screenshot, with right and bottom coordinates exclusive. The crop preserves the displayed photograph's pixels at their original screenshot scale.

== Preservation ==
Wayback copy of this exact original (SHA-256 verified by the central preservation owner): [https://web.archive.org/web/20261122084819/https://swccg.com/wiki/images/0/0a/Dagobah-Revised-L-whaaaaaaaaaoooow-browser-photo.png Internet Archive].
